description: Implementation of the FunctionsGLX class for managing GLX (OpenGL Extension to the X Window System) functions, including dynamic loading of GLX function pointers, extension querying, and context management.

classes.name: FunctionsGLX::GLXFunctionTable
classes.description: Struct holding function pointers for various GLX functions, organized by GLX version and extension.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads GLX function pointers dynamically, checks for extension support, and verifies GLX version.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources, currently a placeholder.

methods.name: hasExtension
methods.description: Checks if a specific GLX extension is supported.

methods.name: getDisplay
methods.description: Returns the associated X Display pointer.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the screen number.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Creates a new GLX rendering context.

methods.name: destroyContext
methods.description: Destroys a given GLX context.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes a GLX context current for a drawable.

methods.name: swapBuffers
methods.description: Swaps the front and back buffers of a drawable.

methods.name: queryExtension
methods.description: Queries if a GLX extension is available.

methods.name: queryVersion
methods.description: Queries the GLX version supported.

methods.name: getCurrentContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current GLX context.

methods.name: getCurrentDrawable
methods.description: Retrieves the current GLX drawable.

methods.name: waitX
methods.description: Waits for X server events.

methods.name: waitGL
methods.description: Waits for GL commands to complete.

methods.name: getClientString
methods.description: Retrieves client-specific string information.

methods.name: queryExtensionsString
methods.description: Retrieves supported GLX extensions as a string.

methods.name: getFBConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves available framebuffer configurations.

methods.name: chooseFBConfig
methods.description: Chooses framebuffer configurations matching attributes.

methods.name: getFBConfigAttrib
methods.description: Gets attributes of a framebuffer configuration.

methods.name: getVisualFromFBConfig
methods.description: Retrieves visual info from a framebuffer config.

methods.name: createWindow
methods.description: Creates a GLX window from a framebuffer config.

methods.name: destroyWindow
methods.description: Destroys a GLX window.

methods.name: createPbuffer
methods.description: Creates a pixel buffer (pbuffer).

methods.name: destroyPbuffer
methods.description: Destroys a pbuffer.

methods.name: queryDrawable
methods.description: Queries attributes of a drawable.

methods.name: createContextAttribsARB
methods.description: Creates a GLX context with specific attributes (ARB extension).

methods.name: swapIntervalEXT
methods.description: Sets swap interval using EXT extension.

methods.name: swapIntervalMESA
methods.description: Sets swap interval using MESA extension.

methods.name: swapIntervalSGI
methods.description: Sets swap interval using SGI extension.

methods.name: getSyncValuesOML
methods.description: Retrieves synchronization values (OML extension).
